$comment: Desktop npm audit baseline (audit PR-06, 2026-10-13). Every entry below was present in `npm audit` for desktop/ on 2026-10-13 (4 moderate / 14 high / 1 critical). Every known fix path is a semver-major upgrade (electron ^33 -> 44.x, electron-builder ^25 -> 26.15.3) or an npm audit fix of the shared build chain, neither of which is safe to apply blindly: electron is the desktop runtime kernel and electron-builder 26 changes packaging behavior. This file is the waiver list consumed by scripts/check-npm-audit.js: any critical/high entry NOT listed here (or a new advisory id / severity escalation on a listed entry) fails the CI gate. Waivers expire on `until` -- an expired entry also fails the gate and forces re-review. Full rationale and links: docs/desktop-supply-chain-audit.md.
